package.name: phm_go2
package.description: Runs the Policy Health Monitor onboard a Unitree GO2 against a real learned policy in shadow mode, without letting the policy or PHM command the robot: a shadow-policy node that publishes the policy latent (ONNX Runtime C++), a probe that calibrates PHM and records its output, a session runner that injects software faults, and tools that reduce a session to numbers and figures. The shadow node additionally needs ONNX Runtime (ONNXRUNTIME_ROOT) and Unitree's unitree_go messages; without them it is skipped.
